children: Shares of Rum Group rose after The Information reported a computing deal with Anthropic worth $13.7 billion, citing a person familiar with the matter.
The stock gained 17% to $8.37 in premarket trading on Monday. As of Friday's market close, shares were up 13% year to date.
According to the news website's report, Anthropic would lease compute capacity at a Maysville, Georgia, data center, which is still being built.
Rum Group had previously disclosed a major contract worth $13.7 billion in an August securities filing but didn't disclose the name of the customer.
